title: Trapped by the Black Widow
description:
You awake to find yourself in a strange bed, with a mysterious woman. How did you get there? Why can't you leave? What's going on? Is it hypnosis? Or something different? And why does it all feel so familiar? Let her take you back, and find out in this mind-bending HFO hypnosis experience.

This file takes you on a journey that can be looped over and over until you're completely lost in it. It's a hypno narrative, but also direct hypnosis, and a trap. A spiralling web of triggers and teasing to hypnotize you.

This file has haptic feedback enabled. To set your device up, use this page .

If you don't have one, order a haptic-enabled device from Lovense with my affiliate link to help me out!
author: Mistress Calia
